brief:
Settlers launched an attack on the village of Mugheir east of Ramallah, leaving a second Palestinian with serious injuries, the Ma'an news agency reported. The Palestinian Red Crescent confirmed the casualty, identifying the victim as sustaining wounds requiring medical attention following the assault.

The incident occurred amid escalating tensions in the occupied West Bank, where Israeli settlers have conducted repeated attacks against Palestinian communities and property. Violence in the Ramallah region has intensified in recent months, with settlers targeting villages across the surrounding areas.
title: Settlers wound second Palestinian in Mugheir attack east of Ramallah
